representations.name: tail periodic-defect measure
representations.new_information: measures the upper-log mass left after a finite periodic subunion rather than only its density increment
representations.first_test: prove the summable-reciprocal and summable-chart criteria exactly

representations.name: offset-slope parameter space
representations.new_information: writes d_j=r_j+s_j and tracks whether infinitely many offsets can be compressed into finitely or summably many affine charts
representations.first_test: test finite offset sets and attempted slope quantisation

representations.name: CRT dependency hypergraph
representations.new_information: records all gcd compatibility intersections, not merely pairwise target isolation
representations.first_test: separate pairwise-coprime, nested, and highly dependent modulus families

representations.name: bounded echo-horizon flow
representations.new_information: uses d_j<=C r_j to place every first echo before (C+1)r_j and follows its descendants across logarithmic windows
representations.first_test: seek a fixed-C charge from transient mass to later periodic mass

representations.name: quotient cell recursion
representations.new_information: divides a confined residue cell by its common gcd and exposes a smaller least-representative system of the same type
representations.first_test: check whether repeated confinement forces vanishing capacity or a stable self-similar obstruction

representations.name: packing cost dual certificate
representations.new_information: pairs finite transient targets with the eventual new density they force after overlaps
representations.first_test: search for a constant K(C) or an explicit finite family with unbounded cost ratio

representations.name: recent signed recurrence certificate
representations.new_information: scores the minimum of several most-recent rises and drops, with age and scale penalties
representations.first_test: rerank fixed schedules and reject historical-range champions

representations.name: fixed infinite rule grammar
representations.new_information: encodes schedules by a finite deterministic rule that is held fixed under every cutoff extension
representations.first_test: evolve rule parameters only on training prefixes, freeze them, then extend blindly

representations.name: coverage-state renewal process
representations.new_information: views activation as immigration and echoes as bounded-delay renewals in logarithmic time
representations.first_test: derive a tightness dichotomy between summable immigration and saturation

representations.name: coprime independence comparator
representations.new_information: uses exact CRT independence as the nearest tractable divergent-reciprocal model
representations.first_test: prove the complete convergent/divergent dichotomy for pairwise coprime moduli
